jobs.title: General Manager Associate - Spain 🇪🇸
jobs.description:
HEALTH CAN’T WAIT. 

Not for symptoms to get worse. Not for a six‑month appointment. Not for a system to catch up. But that’s exactly how healthcare works today. You wait, until you can’t.

Alan exists to end the wait.

Health is a universal right, and we believe this right can only become real when it’s coupled with prevention. We need to stop treating health as something we repair and start treating it as something we build, every day. It’s not solely a question of willpower. It’s the healthcare system itself that needs to work for everyone, in a sustainable way.

So we are building the new standard in prevention insurance. Alan is the first company that integrates insurance, prevention, and care into a single, acclaimed user experience.

We are on an incredible journey to build a global leading company, with a unique culture https://alan.com/en/careers. We already partner with 40K+ companies of all sizes, serving more than 1M+ members, and have reached €800M+ in ARR.

Prevention as the new norm. That's what we're building with our team of 1000+ people. If it speaks to you: we're hiring across France, Spain, Belgium, and Canada. And beyond.




⭐  YOUR MISSIONS ON THIS ROLE ⭐

As an associate, you support the General Manager for Spain (GM) on top business priorities, such as unlocking new growth, driving alignment on strategy and building new processes/standards internally and externally. 

You will be highly involved in key challenges for Alan, supporting the General Manager by completing high added value tasks.



Your missions will include:

Please note that we can’t be exhaustive on the projects you will perform as a GM associate, as you can be asked to help on almost any subject.

 - Corporate & Governance (support for the constitution of our board packs, market research, prepare key meetings, coordinate Monthly Business Reviews...)

 - Growth (supporting marketing initiatives, partnerships...)

 - Brand & Communication (develop the Corporate brand at major business events, write a newsletter, animate social networks)

 - Strategy (contribute to the strategic vision of the company, screen markets and competition, produce business analyses, build models of growth, etc.)

 - Product (identify and explore strategic product opportunities)

 - Talent Acquisition (source and recruit the best team)

 - Team (organize the Spanish off-site, kick-off and key bonding events)



Examples of recent projects by global founder associates team:

 - Finance - Taking part and coordinating a fundraising: preparation of Pitch Deck, financial analysis to assess valuation, coordination of fundraising with investors

 - Product - Exploring health stories: in-depth market research to understand the opportunity to build new health services within Alan

 - Finance - Contributing to a M&A process: involvement on due diligence and valuation, process coordination, and company integration within our community

 - Sales - Being project manager on a key tender: involvement throughout the whole process, coordination of Sales and Product teams to make the best offer possible

 - Logistics - Organizing the annual Alaner reunion event: managing a budget of €600k and a team of 10 people to bring Alaners together over 2 days and create a sense of belonging

 - Recurring tasks - Coordinating the weekly internal communication, supporting the CEO with his weekly newsletter, coordinating the monthly business reviews of the unit.



A unique opportunity to join Alan on a high impact role:

In this position, you will get a great overview of the key strategic topics at Alan and will work with the GM on topics that are instrumental to our success.

You will grow exponentially with the guidance of these senior Alaners. It is a unique chance to work on so many tasks in a different and non traditional environment.




PROFILE & COMPETENCIES

 - We are looking for a candidate with 3-7 years of experience in strategy, operations or consulting.

 - Fluency in spoken and written English and Spanish. All our company communications are written and in English.

 - Sharp analytical thinking: you ask the right questions, break down complex problems, and find solutions backed by solid reasoning.

 - Business sense: you think like an owner, understand what makes a company great, and make good calls even when things are unclear.

 - Strong execution: you drive projects forward and rally others around a shared goal.

 - Versatility: you switch between very different topics without losing impact.

 - Autonomy and rigor: you're organized, reliable, and can own a project from start to finish.

 - Clear communication: you express your needs clearly and inspire others to act.

 - Proactivity: you deliver fast and well, and you go further by spotting problems early and proposing new ideas.

 - Growth mindset: you actively seek feedback and use it to improve.



For this role we are looking to hire within the B1-C1 level range https://alan.com/en/careers/a/salary-equity. 

 


🌍 HOW WE WORK

 - Location: Based in Barcelona or Madrid.

 - Remote work: We offer remote work flexibility.
   
    


🎯 IMPORTANT NOTE: WE HIRE PEOPLE, NOT ROLES.

If you're excited about this opportunity but don't check every box, we'd love to hear from you. Everyone, no matter how underrepresented, should feel free to apply, as it can only bring learnings or success.

If you identify yourself as a woman: Did you know that research shows women often apply only when meeting 100% of requirements?

Remember, this is just a guide, not a checklist. We'll be thrilled to receive your application!

 

🔖 Check out our About Alan https://alan.com/about and Career https://alan.com/careers pages, as well as our Medium https://medium.com/alan, blog https://blog.alan.com/ and Glassdoor page https://www.glassdoor.com/Overview/Working-at-Alan-EI_IE1696043.11,15.htm for more info.

 


YOU WANT TO KNOW MORE ABOUT ALAN?

🙌 Perks & Benefits https://alan.com/en/careers/a/salary-equity: Alaners are provided with a stimulating environment and perks ensuring they are happy, efficient and spend only high-quality time with co-workers.

🤘A strong culture https://alan.com/en/about/a/leadership-principles: People joining Alan are often surprised and delighted by our innovative working method. We have a set of cultural values that guide our approach to work

Alan exists to end the wait.

Health is a universal right, and we believe this right can only become real when it’s coupled with prevention. We need to stop treating health as something we repair and start treating it as something we build, every day. It’s not solely a question of willpower. It’s the healthcare system itself that needs to work for everyone, in a sustainable way.

So we are building the new standard in prevention insurance. Alan is the first company that integrates insurance, prevention, and care into a single, acclaimed user experience.

We are on an incredible journey to build a global leading company, with a unique culture https://alan.com/en/careers. We already partner with 40K+ companies of all sizes, serving more than 1M+ members, and have reached €800M+ in ARR.

Prevention as the new norm. That's what we're building with our team of 1000+ people. If it speaks to you: we're hiring across France, Spain, Belgium, and Canada. And beyond.


⭐️ THE ROLE

You are the Canada GM's right hand. Not a support role: you own strategic initiatives end to end and are accountable for the outcome, not the slide deck.



This seat owns Strategy & Operations: the operating cadence, the operational build-out of a young insurer, and the regulatory execution that lets Alan operate province by province. You'll work daily with Canada's leadership and draw on the global Alan platform, including GM Associate peers in five countries.




🎯 YOUR MISSION

Your core missions:

 - Own Canada's operating cadence. MBRs, QBRs and the Canada Weekly pulse: turn inputs from nine communities into the narrative and decisions leadership acts on.

 - Build new operations from scratch. New products, processes and reporting (e.g. virtual care expansion, pipeline and quota dashboards): define, launch, hand over.

 - Own insurance & regulatory execution. Provincial licensing, other filings and clinical licensing for new provinces. These are commitments to regulators, not internal deadlines.

 - Build your own AI tooling. Automate your own job with agents that do real work (e.g. automate weekly reporting, hiring pipeline digests, regulatory monitoring).

 - Lead through influence and clarity. Write the docs that let others decide without you (e.g. the business case for a 2nd GM Associate, summer interns, staffing BC expansion) and keep Canada and Europe aligned.

 - Step in where the business needs you. Cover leaders when they're out and pick up adjacent work (e.g. running hiring loops, managing summer interns, running the Toronto office).




💪 YOU MAY BE A GREAT FIT IF YOU HAVE

 - 1-4 years in consulting, banking, M&A, a high-growth startup, or as a founder.

 - Strategic thinking with hands-on execution. You set direction, then build the model, fix the process and file the renewal on time.

 - Exceptional written communication. You can turn a messy quarter into three paragraphs a board will act on.

 - A real command of AI tools, used to extend your output, not replace your thinking. We'll ask you to show us.

 - Strong organisation, time management and autonomy. You run projects start to finish with precision and little oversight.

 - An entrepreneurial mindset. Comfortable with ambiguity, you take ownership beyond your remit.

 - Mission-driven. You want to transform healthcare in Canada.

 - Based in Toronto and in our office 5 days a week.

 - As a plus: French, international team experience, or a background in scale-ups, healthcare or insurance.



Earlier in your career? Apply anyway. If you've shown real ownership (a company you started, a team you carried, work that shipped), we'd rather see your application than screen you out on a number.




🚀 WHAT THIS ROLE LEADS TO

The role is built on a minimum two-year horizon: long enough to compound real impact, and the springboard to leading a community or function. You'll have a buddy and a coach from day one.




🙌 PERKS & BENEFITS

 - Competitive salary + equity - B0-C1, ($96-140k CAD) see the salary & equity grid https://alan.com/en/careers/a/salary-equity.

 - Monthly TTC pass, and a generous employer matching program for your RRSP.

 - Excellent health coverage through Alan's own app.

 - Office at King & Yonge in the financial district, with free lunch.

 - Flexible leave, no pre-approval needed.

 - Personal growth through coaching. Every Alaner has a dedicated coach from day one. Read about our coaching culture https://alan.com/en/blog/discover-alan/a/alan-culture-excellence-through-coaching.

This is a hands-on leadership role. You will develop the team and its managers while remaining personally involved in the most strategic and complex opportunities.

Your responsibilities will include:

 - Owning the Belgian sales strategy, revenue plan, and performance against growth targets.

 - Leading and developing a sales organisation of approximately 40 people, including managers and individual contributors.

 - Recruiting, onboarding, coaching, and retaining a high-performing team, while building clear career paths for its members.

 - Establishing the right sales methodology, processes, metrics, and operating rhythm to make performance predictable and scalable.

 - Personally supporting the most strategic and complex deals, particularly across enterprise and public-sector accounts.

 - Partnering with Marketing, Product, Sales Operations, and other teams to improve lead generation, sales efficiency, customer feedback loops, and market positioning.

 - Ensuring strong alignment between the Belgian go-to-market strategy and Alan’s global commercial approach.

 - Working closely with the Belgian GM and other senior stakeholders to turn market opportunities into sustainable growth.
   
   


⭐️ IS IT WHAT YOU ARE LOOKING FOR? ⭐️

You could be a strong fit for this role if you:

 - Have significant experience leading, coaching, and scaling B2B sales teams, including through managers or team leads.

 - Have delivered growth in complex and competitive sales environments, ideally involving enterprise, public-sector, or other long sales cycles.

 - Are comfortable combining strategic leadership with hands-on involvement in important customer opportunities.

 - Know how to build a high-performance sales culture through clear goals, strong coaching, effective processes, and data-driven management.

 - Are fluent in Dutch and English. French-speaking or French-understanding skills are a plus.

 - Are willing to work from our Brussels office several days per week to build strong relationships with the team and stay close to the business.

Experience in HR, healthcare, insurance, employee benefits, or banking is a plus, as is familiarity with recognised sales methodologies.

So we are building the new standard in prevention insurance. Alan is the first company that integrates insurance, prevention, and care into a single, acclaimed user experience.

Prevention as the new norm. That's what we're building with our team of 1000+ people. If it speaks to you: we're hiring across France, Spain, Belgium, and Canada. And beyond.

We are looking for an experienced Partnership Manager to join our Accountant Partnerships team in France, specifically focused on building and developing relationships with accounting firms and accountant networks.

The core purpose of this role is to turn accounting firms into long-term Alan partners and advocates. You will help them recommend Alan to their clients, improve their day-to-day experience with health insurance and payroll administration, and generate qualified business opportunities for Alan’s Sales teams.

The accountant ecosystem represents a significant growth opportunity for Alan. France has approximately 22,000 accounting firms supporting around 3.5 million companies, and Alan’s existing Accountant Partnership channel has already generated significant ARR through a relatively small number of partners.

The team is now entering a new phase of development. We are hiring new Partnership Manager to help build a scalable, high-performing partner network and contribute to Alan’s ambition to make Accountant Partnerships a strategic growth channel.

Here is how your key outcomes will look like:

 1. Build and grow a strong partner network: Identify, prioritise and develop relationships with high-potential accounting firms and networks.

 2. Drive partnerships from discussion to activation: Lead partnership discussions, onboarding and launch, ensuring that Alan creates value for both accountants and their clients.

 3. Activate partners and generate business opportunities: Build engagement plans, support partner enablement and work closely with Sales to turn recommendations into qualified opportunities.

 4. Help scale the Accountant Partnerships model: Manage partner performance, share insights with internal teams and contribute to the development of scalable playbooks, tools and processes.


⭐ IS IT YOU WE’RE LOOKING FOR?

We’re looking for someone who combines strong partnership and commercial skills with the ability to build trusted relationships in a complex and evolving B2B ecosystem.

The ideal candidate will be comfortable managing partnerships from initial contact to activation and long-term development. They should enjoy working autonomously in an environment where there is still a lot to build.

You may be a great fit at Alan if you have/are:

 - 5+ years of experience in partnerships, business development, account management or customer success in a B2B environment

 - Experience managing partnerships throughout the full lifecycle, from prospecting and closing to activation and ongoing relationship management

 - Experience managing a portfolio of partners, ideally in a fast-growing company

 - Strong negotiation, communication, presentation and relationship-building skills

 - A data-oriented mindset, with the ability to track performance and prioritise opportunities

 - The ability to collaborate effectively with Sales, Marketing, Product, Data and Operations teams

 - An entrepreneurial mindset, strong ownership and the ability to work autonomously

 - Full professional fluency in French and professional fluency in English

Experience working directly with accounting firms, payroll providers, HR software or insurance companies would be a strong plus.

We are particularly interested in candidates who have experience with B2B distribution partnerships, where a third party recommends or distributes a solution to its own customers. Experience limited to technology integrations, co-marketing or visibility partnerships would be less relevant for this role.

For this opportunity, we are aiming to hire within the C0-D level https://alan.com/en/careers/a/salary-equity.

Everything else is a plus. We care about having a diversity of experiences, profiles and backgrounds in our team.



🙌 PERKS & BENEFITS https://alan.com/about/life-at-alan/a/perks

At Alan, we believe that being in good health is a basic need, and it starts with our employees. This is why Alaners are provided with a stimulating environment and perks ensuring they are happy, efficient and spend only high-quality time with co-workers.

Therefore, we offer:

 - Fair rewards. Generous equity packages complement your base salary, for permanent contracts only.

 - Flexible office with hybrid setup. Amazing office space at our Paris HQ or sponsored co-working hubs in Bordeaux, Marseille, Lyon, Annecy, Nantes or Biarritz.

 - All the tools you need. Top of the range equipment: Macbook Air, keyboard, laptop stand, monitor, and Bose noise-canceling headphones.

 - Flexible vacation policy and flexible working hours. Organize your time as you wish.

 - Delightful healthcare insurance: Extremely comprehensive health insurance - 100% for you and your children, 90-100% for partners depending on your country (permanent contracts only).

 - Transport. Generous transit benefit

 - Learning & Training opportunities. A highly flexible training policy free books and budget to attend and speak at conferences if the opportunity arises.

 - Personal growth through coaching: At Alan, coaching isn't just a perk - it's core to who we are. Every Alaner is paired with a dedicated coach from day one, who helps maximize their impact, nurture engagement, and navigate Alan's values to develop their full potential. Learn more about our coaching culture https://alan.com/en/blog/discover-alan/a/alan-culture-excellence-through-coaching.

 - Parental leave. Extended parental leave for all new parents, for permanent contracts only.


IMPORTANT NOTE: WE HIRE PEOPLE NOT ROLES.

After reading this job description, if you feel like you don’t have all the necessary prerequisites but that it matches where you are now or what you'd like to grow into in your next position, we encourage you to apply!

Not everybody will enter our recruitment process, but all, no matter how underrepresented, should feel free to apply as it can only bring learnings or success.

Prevention as the new norm. That's what we're building with our team of 1000+ people. If it speaks to you: we're hiring across France, Spain, Belgium, and Canada. And beyond.




🚀 THE CHALLENGE 🚀

Customer Success Specialists (CSS) ensure a smooth onboarding journey to key accounts and provide ongoing support throughout their partnership with Alan.

They are accountable for operational excellence and long-term satisfaction of our most strategic accounts and play a critical role as Alan continue expanding Enterprise and Public sector partnerships.

We are looking for senior professionals able to scale the role's process and guidelines as we move forward. The goal is to set the standards for our customized approach to onboarding!



👩‍💻 Helping Our Admins

Your primary mission is to ensure operational excellence and an outstanding admin experience across a portfolio of key accounts (5 to 10 accounts per CSS). You'll be the go-to expert for complex admin topics such as affiliations, payroll management, invoicing, and billing—delivering meaningful, proactive, and delightful support while building deep expertise along the way.

You will:

 - Train and onboard admins on Alan's product, workflows, and best practices (remote and occasionally onsite): affiliation lifecycle, payroll management, invoicing, and more

 - Own admin support end-to-end for your account portfolio: handle requests, investigate issues, coordinate with internal teams, and ensure timely resolution

 - Manage complex or sensitive conversations with admins (objections, escalations, high-stakes operational topics) with clarity and empathy

 - Anticipate risks (missing affiliations, payroll edge cases, invoicing issues) and prevent blockers before they impact admins



👷 Building the role in Belgium

Prevention as the new norm. That's what we're building with our team of 1000+ people. If it speaks to you: we're hiring across France, Spain, Belgium, and Canada. And beyond.


⭐ YOUR MISSION

Brokers play a structural role in how large and very large employers select, negotiate, and manage their health and prévoyance coverage. We're looking for a Broker Partnerships Lead to build and animate Alan's relationships with the brokers who operate in the Enterprise segment, turning Alan into a trusted, credible, and commercially compelling partner for those actors, and supporting our Enterprise Sales and Key Account Management teams.




⭐ LOCATION

On-site in Paris, Île-de-France.

What makes this role genuinely unique

 - You'll shape how one of Europe's fastest-growing health insurance companies builds its relationships with the brokers operating in the large and very large employer segment across France, and beyond.

 - You'll have real ownership from day one and operate at the highest levels of the broker market.

 - You'll shape Alan’s broker strategy and execute it. Alan is at an early stage of building this capability. The playbook is yours to define and scale.

 - You'll work directly with Alan's Enterprise Sales, Key Account Management, Insurance, and Executive Leadership.




⭐ YOUR ROLE

Relationships & Presence

 - Build and maintain trusted, long-term relationships with the brokers that sit between us and the largest employers in our markets (whether private or public), at senior and managing director level.

 - Map the ecosystem, prioritize interlocutors, and design Alan's engagement strategy.

 - Be the consistent Alan voice that brokers recognize: someone who shows up, follows through, and is known as easy to deal with without giving away what shouldn't be given.



Partnership with Alan's Enterprise & Commercial work

 - Be a partner to our Enterprise Sales and KAM teams on every broker situation: drive strategic decisions deal by deal and turn ecosystem knowledge into commercial leverage.

 - Introduce the right broker contacts at the right moment in the commercial cycle,  transforming relationship capital into pipeline access on large and very large accounts.

 - Share Alan's value and positioning with broker partners to help them understand, represent, and actively promote Alan within their client portfolios.

 - Hold the line on our non-negotiables while finding creative ways to make the collaboration work for both sides.



Sector Engagement & Anticipation

 - Follow the broker market at deal level and ecosystem level: who is growing, who is consolidating, where portfolio shifts are happening, and what it means for Alan's pipeline and positioning.

 - Be a sharp, early internal voice on where the broker market is heading and on the implications for Alan's strategy, including on consolidation, regulation, and competitive dynamics.



Build & Scale

 - Knowledge base: Build and maintain a knowledge library on broker positions, portfolio footprints, engagement history, and contractual frameworks shared with Enterprise Sales and KAM teams to increase win rates.

 - Framework & tools: Implement processes and AI tools to improve the quality and efficiency of our broker engagement and contract documentation (conventions de courtage, commission tracking, data sharing agreements).

 - Collaboration: Share best practices with the broader Enterprise & Commercial team and contribute proven methodologies to their scaled commercial operations.

 - Market intelligence: Provide competitive intelligence on how brokers position Alan vs. incumbents, how they advise clients on insurer selection, and where we are perceived as "difficult to work with" — and feed that back into product, pricing, and GTM strategy.




⭐ IS IT YOU WE’RE LOOKING FOR?

You’ll be a great fit for this opportunity if you:

 - Have at least 8 years of total experience working with or inside the broker ecosystem: at a broker or in an external partnership or distribution role at a health insurer or mutuelle

 - Have legitimate credibility at senior broker level: ability to engage managing director and senior leadership at major brokers as a peer, built through a personal representative past or years of substantive deal-level engagement on the insurer or employer side

 - Have deep knowledge of the broker ecosystem in the large and very large employer segment: how brokers operate, how they are compensated, how they advise clients, and how they influence insurer selection at this scale

 - Have deep understanding of health and prévoyance insurance: the technical dimension (garanties, gestion, régimes, prévoyance) must be native, not learned on the job

 - Have proven ability to build trust with broker counterparts from the insurer or employer side: long-game, trustworthy, discreet, commercially disciplined

 - Demonstrate outstanding stakeholder management: calm, ego-free, able to represent Alan substantively without making it about yourself and equally able to hold firm positions internally when sales pressure pushes toward broker accommodation beyond our framework

 - Demonstrate commercial impact from prior broker-related work: broker relationships that translated into material deal flow, pipeline access, or portfolio migration

 - Are a self-starter: comfortable building from scratch in a fast-paced, high-growth environment with limited process and real autonomy

 - Are ego-free and lever-minded: you accelerate others, you don't seek the spotlight

Learn more about our coaching culture https://alan.com/en/blog/discover-alan/a/alan-culture-excellence-through-coaching.

Prevention as the new norm. That's what we're building with our team of 1000+ people. If it speaks to you: we're hiring across France, Spain, Belgium, and Canada. And beyond.

Alan operates at the intersection of health insurance, prevention, and regulated data. The person in this role owns the security governance and risk posture of a company that handles sensitive health data for 1M+ members, operates under DORA and HDS certification requirements, and is regulated by the ACPR. They work in close partnership with Legal, Internal Audit, and the broader Risk function. It's a highly collaborative role.




🛡️ YOUR MISSION: GOVERNANCE, RISK & COMPLIANCE

Own and operate the ISO 27001 ISMS. You are the accountable owner of the Information Security Management System: scope definition, Statement of Applicability, internal audit programme, and management review. You've led at least one full certification or recertification cycle and know what breaks down in the months between audits.

Be the security expert on regulatory and privacy matters. Legal leads on DORA, HDS, RGPD, PGSSI-S, and regulatory relationships. Your role is to bring the technical and operational security substance: translating regulatory requirements into controls, flagging implementation gaps, and making sure the security programme is solid when the regulatory team negotiates with the ACPR or ANS.

Run risk as an ongoing programme, in partnership with the broader risk function. You lead security risk cartography using EBIOS RM and ensure it feeds into, and is informed by, the company-wide risk framework. You facilitate risk workshops, produce treatment plans, and bring the security lens to forums where non-security risks are also on the table. You know when a security risk is really a business risk.

Own the controls framework, but distribute ownership of controls themselves. You define the framework, set the standards, and track coverage, but the controls live with the teams who build and run the things they protect. You work closely with Infrastructure, Platform, and Engineering to ensure foundational building blocks (identity, network, secrets management, logging) are designed with security requirements built in from the start. You work alongside those teams as a partner.

Run audit cycles with rigour, in close partnership with Internal Audit. You manage the security audit programme and coordinate with certification bodies. You work with Internal Audit to align scopes, avoid duplication, and present a coherent picture of control effectiveness to the board. You've sat in joint audit planning sessions and know how to make that relationship work well.

Manage third-party risk. You run vendor security assessments and define contractual security requirements (security annexes, DPAs). You partner with our Risk team, which oversees third-party risk, and own the security dimension.

Bring the health sector context. You understand the ANS framework, CERT Santé requirements, and what it means to handle sensitive health data in day-to-day operations. You're a useful partner to Legal when the question is "what does this regulation actually require us to do technically?"

Own incident governance and support DORA reporting. You classify and escalate ICT incidents internally, own BCP and DRP governance, and provide the security substance for DORA incident reports.




🚀 WHAT YOU'LL BUILD AND WHO YOU'LL WORK WITH

Compliance Framework: ISO 27001, DORA, HDS, NIS2. Multiple regulators, multiple countries, one coherent governance backbone. Build the system that lets Alan scale from 1M to many millions of members without rebuilding compliance every time.

Automated Audit & Evidence Engine: Replace manual evidence collection with scripted pipelines plugged directly into engineering systems. Turn audit cycles into a continuous capability instead of a quarterly rush.

Risk Cartography: Risk treated as an operational signal that feeds directly into business and engineering decisions, with EBIOS RM at the core.

You'll work closely with Legal, DPO, Internal Audit, and the broader Risk function, and partner day-to-day with Infrastructure, Platform, Engineering, Product, and Operations. You're the bridge between regulatory complexity and operational simplicity.




⚡ WHY THIS ROLE IS SPECIAL

Direct Impact: You own the trust foundation that lets Alan handle health data for 1M+ members and operate in highly regulated markets. Your work is the precondition for everything else Alan does.

Complex Problems: 4 regulators across 4 countries, sensitive health data, and a regulatory landscape that keeps shifting (DORA, NIS2, AI Act), all to be modeled into a single, coherent control system.

Ownership & Growth: Board and executive exposure, real influence on company-wide risk decisions, and the autonomy to shape Alan's security culture across 800+ people.




🤝 WHAT YOU WILL ALSO DO: TECHNICAL ENABLEMENT

Automate compliance work wherever possible. You script evidence collection, automate control testing, and connect GRC tooling to engineering pipelines. You've used Python or similar to reduce the manual work of an audit cycle, and you actively look for the next process to streamline.

Configure and own GRC tooling. You can administer platforms like CISO Assistant, ServiceNow GRC, or Archer, designing workflows, building dashboards, and making them genuinely useful for the teams that feed them data.

Speak cloud governance fluently. You understand shared responsibility in HDS-qualified environments, know what CSPM tools surface and what they miss, and can reason about policy-as-code (OPA, SCP) without needing an engineer to translate.

Read architecture well enough to challenge it. You can review a proposed architecture, identify control gaps in identity, network segmentation, encryption, or logging, and push back credibly with engineers even though you're not one.

Interpret vulnerability data and drive prioritisation. You read scan outputs, work with engineering teams to prioritise remediation by business impact over CVSS score alone, and track resolution KPIs over time.




⭐️ QUALIFICATIONS, MINDSET AND SOFT SKILLS

You translate risk into business language. You can brief a board or an audit committee and leave them genuinely informed. You know the difference between a finding that requires an emergency board call and one that belongs in a quarterly report.

You influence without authority. You align Legal, DPO, Risk, Engineering, Product, and Operations on security requirements without creating blockers or adversarial dynamics. People come to you early because you make their work easier.

You manage programmes with audit-grade rigor. You run structured, traceable roadmaps. You know where every commitment is, who owns it, and when it's due. You escalate proactively and don't let dependencies surprise you.

You build a genuine security culture. Your awareness programmes land because they're relevant to the people who take them. You foster proportionate risk ownership across the company, so teams make better day-to-day decisions.

You think in principles when frameworks shift. DORA is live. NIS2 transposition pace varies. The AI Act is arriving. When the regulatory landscape moves, you reason from first principles and adapt without waiting to be told what to do.




🌍 HOW WE WORK

Location: You must be legally eligible to work from France, Belgium or Spain.

Remote work: We offer remote work flexibility, but we value in-person collaboration

If you're excited about this opportunity but don't check every box, we'd love to hear from you. Everyone, no matter how underrepresented, should feel free to apply, as it can only bring learnings or success.
